summary: Tested TWAS REPAIR unified app - all requested features working correctly. Login shows 'TWAS REPAIR' title. Supervisor dashboard has 3 tabs (Timesheets, Rel. Serviço, Rel. Diário). Service Reports tab shows 1 report with OS 2506-37. Daily Reports tab shows 2 reports with OS 2506-37. Criar Novo modal has 3 options (Timesheet, Relatório de Serviço, Relatório Diário). Admin dashboard has cards for Relatórios de Serviço and Relatórios Diários. All navigation and external API integration working.

issues: The greeting shows 'Bem-vindo, João Silva' which is correct - user name is being fetched properly from backend

critical_code_review_comments: External API integration (reportsApi.ts) works correctly with axios interceptor for token management
AuthContext properly stores credentials for re-auth with external report API via ensureReportAuth()
Tab switching works correctly with activeTab state management
Criar Novo modal navigation works for all 3 options
Admin dashboard correctly routes to service-reports and daily-reports pages
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data from external API
context_for_next_testing_agent: All unified app features working correctly. External report API at https://twas-repair-preview.preview.emergentagent.com/api is live and returns 3 reports (2 daily, 1 service) for OS 2506-37. The ensureReportAuth() function in AuthContext handles re-authentication with stored credentials. Tab navigation in supervisor dashboard uses text-based selectors since data-testid may not work reliably in Expo Web.
